highlights.title: Melting Himalayas? Nepal disaster exposes growing risk of glacial flooding
highlights.summary: One of the tragic consequences of global warming. Scientists will tell us whether receding glaciers are to blame for last Wednesday’s ice shelf collapse that triggered a catastrophic flood, cascading down more than 3,000 meters from the Chinese border into Nepal.
